== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Travelers are individuals associated with specific Territories, such as [[Endross]], [[Valinhall]], [[Tartarus]], [[Naraka]], [[Avernus]], [[Asphodel]], [[Helgard]], [[Ornheim]], [[Lirial]], and [[Elysia]]. To become a [[Traveler]], individuals must pass [[compatibility tests]] to ensure they can connect with their respective [[Territory]]. While some Travelers are born from specific bloodlines, others undergo training. The nature of their abilities varies significantly depending on their origin; for example, [[Lirial Travelers]] traditionally focus on gathering information and acting as sentinels, while [[Tartarus Travelers]] function as soldiers, and [[Naraka Traveler|Naraka Travelers]] can summon burning insects. [[Endross Travelers]] are known for utilizing white lightning, whereas [[Valinhall Travelers]] are uniquely specialized in combat against other Travelers. Some believe the name refers to the ability to move between locations rapidly, though this is not universal across all Territories. Travelers often exhibit distinct physical traits or attire, such as feathers or specific colored coats, and may be identified by their tribal affiliations. Despite their diverse powers, many Travelers are considered psychologically unstable due to the stress of existing alongside different worlds. In certain social structures, Travelers may serve as guards or soldiers, though they are sometimes assigned to duties as a form of punishment for incompetence. In rare instances, if a [[Traveler]] loses control, they may become an [[Incarnation]].}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Travelers are frequently observed within the [[Damascan royal army]] camp. During their time in [[Avernus]], members of this group served as escorts for [[Alin]]. While some Travelers faced various dangers such as fireballs and giant birds, the actions of [[Adessa]] resulted in the loss of six lives among their number. Despite their presence, there are concerns that they may be ineffective when facing [[Kai]].}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|During combat within the camp, Travelers demonstrated their ability to call objects from their respective Territories. One such [[Territory]] is [[Valinhall]], which exists solely for the purpose of killing other Travelers. While some Travelers actively avoid [[Grandmasters]], others are capable of attacking [[Incarnations]], though they can also be deceived or waylaid by them. [[Leah]] intends to deploy parties of Travelers in the future and has been observed standing behind a defensive wall composed of [[Golems|golems]] and Travelers.}}
